awakening_implementation: 30 awakening stones; essence acquisition grants one innate starter per essence; stones fill remaining two slots
awakening_stone_source_provenance: 12 community_listed_known_rarity; 3 community_listed_rarity_unknown; 15 mod_original_unverified; themes, affinities and imprint designs are mod-original
gameplay_power_status: v0.18 70 playable powers of at least 100 planned; advanced abilities pending automated and in-game tests
release_notes: Add 20 playable techniques including teleports, summons, delayed blasts, reflective shields, temporary barriers, healing fields and spatial targeting.

progression.requirements: All highest-ever-configured ability slots within each essence must be awakened and reach the next rank.

xp_sources.damage: effective damage dealt to any pawn independent of faction, using DamageResult with injury-delta fallback

stat_bonus_per_tier.Power: Iron 4%; Bronze 8%; Silver 16%; Gold 32%; Diamond 64% essence damage
stat_bonus_per_tier.Speed: Iron 2.5%; Bronze 5%; Silver 10%; Gold 20%; Diamond 40% cooldown reduction
stat_bonus_per_tier.Spirit: Iron 5%; Bronze 10%; Silver 20%; Gold 40%; Diamond 80% buff duration
stat_bonus_per_tier.Recovery: Iron 6%; Bronze 12%; Silver 24%; Gold 48%; Diamond 96% healing

progression.rank_bonus_behavior: total per-essence affinity bonus doubles at every rank, not a flat additive amount
progression.sublevel_attribute_bonuses: linear interpolation from current major-rank multiplier to next doubled major-rank multiplier, step 1/10, using the lowest required ability level per essence
progression.tier_synchronization: Training in any major tier Bronze or above pauses when another currently owned essence has not reached that tier.
progression.migration: Existing rankWork from v0.11 converted to saved 0..9 sublevels and fractional work without rerolling existing affinity.

world_integration.magic_density: computed live from colony wealth, population, average best combat skill, and the rank/sublevels of owned essences; not rolled per map
world_integration.auto_event: per player home map, one random check per in-game day, density-scaled
world_integration.tear: visible 900-tick open countdown, one active tear per map
world_integration.monster_chance: 15%-80% based on density, if monsters are enabled
world_integration.vanilla_monster_placeholders: Megascarab at low density, Warg at medium, Thrumbo at high
world_integration.loot: Astral Loot targets marked manifestation corpse; one normal essence, corpse consumed
world_integration.loot_power_access: universal to Essencebound pawns in prototype; later replace with essence-specific powers
world_integration.qa: Mod Settings display live density and factors; Dev Mode pawn button forces a tear using the latest density
world_integration.loot_targeting: nearby marked corpse FloatMenu plus map-cell targeting fallback
world_integration.loot_troubleshooting: distinct rejection reasons for unmarked, out-of-range or obstructed remains
world_integration.dynamic_density: recomputed when density is queried; affects the next tear event roll and future tears; active tears retain their opening-density snapshot
world_integration.saved_compatibility: v0.13 ebAmbientDensity ignored; ebNextManifestationCheck preserved, no save schema change for essence users

monster_progression.ranks_source: tear opening density snapshot from current colony strength
monster_progression.generated_creatures: Megascarab Iron, Warg Bronze, Thrumbo Silver/Gold/Diamond; creature sprites still placeholders
monster_progression.rank_inspection: manifestation hediff stage label shows major tier; spawn message reports tier
monster_progression.damage_reduction: Gold takes exactly 20% (80% reduction) and Diamond 1% (99% reduction) of unranked pawn damage; Iron 80%, Bronze 60%, Silver 40%. Ranked attackers use defender baseline / attacker baseline; equal/higher rank takes no reduction.
monster_progression.implementation: Harmony 3 patch Pawn.PreApplyDamage; requires separate Harmony mod
monster_progression.ranked_attacker_rule: When attacker's major rank is below defender's, multiply incoming pawn-instigated damage by defender's unranked-damage factor divided by attacker's. Equal or higher ranked attackers are unaffected.

ability_expansion.awakenings: new powers integrate with existing aspect-matching weighted stone selection
ability_expansion.progression: damage spells credit effective damage; restoration actual injury healing; cleansing only removed statuses; buffs and enemy control active duration
ability_expansion.save_compatibility: existing ability IDs, rank fields and unlocked powers preserved; new starters only for newly absorbed essences

ability_plan.target_semantics: a planned design is not playable until it has a working effect implementation, XML def, valid awakening mappings and tests
